likelyQuestions: Solve the recurrence relation T(N) = 3T(N/3) + N^2 using appropriate methods.
Derive and solve the divide and conquer recurrence for Merge Sort and analyze its worst-case complexity.
Apply Strassen's matrix multiplication algorithm to a given pair of 2x2 matrices, detailing each step.
Find an optimal Huffman code for a given set of character frequencies and explain the prefix-free property.
Determine the cost and structure of an optimal binary search tree for a given set of keys and access probabilities.
Solve the all-pairs shortest path problem using the Floyd-Warshall algorithm for a given directed weighted graph.
Explain the N-Queen problem and formulate the state-space tree for solving the 4-Queen problem using backtracking.
Describe the working principle of the Knuth-Morris-Pratt (KMP) string matching algorithm and compute the prefix function (pi table) for a given pattern.
Perform the Rabin-Karp string matching algorithm step by step for a given pattern and text using a specified prime modulus.
State the subset sum problem, prove its NP-completeness using polynomial-time reduction, and outline an approximate solution.
